# Class Of Learners

> Class Of Learners is an independent student software studio based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. The studio builds interactive learning software, real-time 3D web simulations, touch typing engines, browser utilities, and accessibility experiments. All applications are 100% free, client-side capable, open, and free of paywalls or invasive tracking.

## Entity Overview

- **Organization**: Class Of Learners (Educational Technology Studio)
- **Founding Location**: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **Origin**: CBSE Bhavani Shankar School student engineering initiative
- **Core Focus**: Learning by doing, accessible STEM tools, digital inclusion (Sneh Asha), and browser-native computing
- **Canonical Website**: https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/
- **Production Mirrors**: https://col.dpdns.org/

## Primary Pages

- [Studio Hub](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/): Central interactive showcase of learning projects, student engineering tools, and 3D web applications.
- [About Us](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/about): Team background, educational philosophy, student-led structure, and mission.
- [CBSE Bhavani Shankar School](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/school): The foundational school environment and academic community in Mumbai that inspired Class Of Learners.
- [The Making](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/making): Deep dive into the studio's technical architecture, Three.js 3D rendering pipeline, procedural generation, and local AI workflows.
- [Sneh Asha](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/sneh-asha): Social impact and digital divide initiative delivering lightweight educational software for low-resource environments.

## Interactive Learning Products

- [Mumbai Traffic Academy](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Traffic/Academy): Interactive traffic education with 57 progressive rule levels, quizzes, road sign mastery, and downloadable completion certificates.
- [Mumbai Traffic Driving Simulator](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Traffic/Driving): High-performance 3D urban driving simulator built with Three.js to practice defensive driving and Mumbai traffic laws.
- [Solar Engine 3D](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/solar): Real-time WebGL celestial simulator featuring accurate planetary orbits, physical scales, planetary composition metrics, and space exploration.
- [Advanced Typing Instructor (ATI)](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/ati): Adaptive touch-typing coach with 200 skill levels, real-time WPM/accuracy tracking, code syntax modules (JS, Python, C++, HTML), and multiplayer typing races.
- [Terra3D](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Terra3D/): Interactive 3D planetary globe for exploring continents, country metrics, geopolitical boundaries, and geographic landmarks.

## Productivity & Utility Tools

- [Perceptus Flow](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/gesture): Touchless computer navigation using standard webcams and MediaPipe computer vision. Supports air-pointing, three-finger clicking, two-finger scrolling, and virtual air-drawing with 100% local client-side processing.
- [QR Editor](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/qr-editor): Professional static and dynamic QR code designer. Features custom linear/radial gradients, embedded logo images, customizable corner markers, scan analytics, password-protected redirects, and SVG/PNG vector downloads with zero limits.
- [CastFlow](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/CastFlow): High-efficiency browser tool for wireless screen casting, multi-window desktop mode (DeX-style UI), and local network file sharing.
- [FutureScape Career Guide](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/Career): Interactive career mapping platform covering 440+ professions, entrance exams, compensation tiers, and AI displacement resilience analysis.
- [Software Downloads](https://advancedlogiclabs.dpdns.org/download): Desktop binaries (Windows .exe, Linux .deb and .tar.gz), Android APK packages, and PWA installs.
